args.title: Persist export format choice in localStorage in src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to remember the last chosen export format in localStorage so that it persists across report views and sessions in the browser, instead of resetting to the default format every time.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton currently initializes its format state from a default value without saving to or checking localStorage, which causes the format to reset every time a report is opened. Updating the component to read and write the selected format in localStorage will allow the chosen format to persist across report views and browser sessions.
